mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significant (p>0.05) in more than 50% of 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 250 (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS <= 2.0%) and CPIAUCSL exceeds 250, the market anticipates a policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 2.0 and CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1200 (HOUST < 1200) signals weak demand for residential construction, indicating a slowing economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production (INDPRO > 105), the economy is expanding strongly, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE > 4.0) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between GDPC1 and 20d SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significant (p>0.05) in more than 50% of 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS < 150000) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 150000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.
